subgoals: Read the leakage value for each when condition
Sum leakage weighted by state probability

label: Internal power tables
subgoals: Read energy per transition from the internal power table at the grid point

Exclude the external load's charging from internal energy

label: Total pin power and noise views
section: Total pin power and noise views

Multiply by the toggle rate for total pin power
Use noise views for glitch tolerance and victim holding resistance
